DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma

Given your 40-year history of alcohol use and 50-year history of heavy smoking, combined with your age and the classic signs of obstructive jaundice (pale stools, dark urine, pruritus, and weight loss), the most likely cause is a malignancy of the bile ducts. The mention of previous upper abdominal pain also raises concern for prior biliary issues.
